title: Wordless reunion
user_context: Write a short scene (4-6 sentences) in which two estranged brothers meet again at their father's grave. Hard constraints: they must NOT speak a single word of dialogue; the season is winter; and the older brother, Eli, must be the point-of-view character.

compiler_inputs.user_request: Write a short scene (4-6 sentences) in which two estranged brothers meet again at their father's grave. Hard constraints: they must NOT speak a single word of dialogue; the season is winter; and the older brother, Eli, must be the point-of-view character.
compiler_inputs.scene_context: a churchyard in winter, two estranged brothers, their father's grave
compiler_inputs.voice_profile: restrained close third on Eli, past tense
compiler_inputs.character_state: years of silence between them; grief and pride
compiler_inputs.invention_budget: moderate: you may invent gesture, weather, and setting detail within the constraints

required_changes.desc: no quoted dialogue is allowed in this scene (no double-quote marks)
the winter setting must be present in the imagery
Eli must be the named point-of-view character

forbidden_changes.desc: do not resolve the estrangement with a speech

authorized_spans.desc: the whole scene is authored under the stated constraints

acceptable_output_properties: winter is felt, not just named
